acknowledged.reason: A timing side channel in RSA and in CBC/ECB decryption under LLVM's select-optimize, fixed in no release. The vendored subset has no RSA and decrypts only with GCM, CTR and CCM; the boards build with GCC.
A non-constant-time secret comparison in Prosody before 0.11.9; NVD names Lua 5.2 and later only as the runtime Prosody runs under. Nothing in Lua itself is affected, and the console runs no Prosody.
